descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Construcții, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
The Company:
 Our customer provides comprehensive operational support and a range of expert services to the world’s leading insurers, brokers, fleet managers, and automotive manufacturers. Our 3,300 employees across ten countries deliver exceptional standards on a large scale for over 1,200 clients. We help the global insurance market handle millions of claims each year in the most cost-effective and efficient ways possible.
The Group is embarking on an exciting and challenging transformation program, and our software solutions are a driving force behind this strategy using cloud computing and leading-edge design patterns.
 The Role:
 This is a great opportunity for an experienced DevOps to join our super-motivated DevOps team, be part of one of our existing customers' teams.
 Key Responsibilities:
Design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure and shared platform services
Design and align Cloud architecture with customer
Own and drive architectural topics with the solution architect, client, and stakeholders
Maintain and evolve existing Azure environments, including building newinfrastructure from scratch
Drive DevOps best practices related to scalability, reliability, security, and automation
Improve CI/CD processes, pipelines, and automation
Improve monitoring, alerting, and overall operational visibility
Collaborate closely with development teams to enable efficient and stable delivery
Participate in development team stand-ups and technical discussions as a DevOps lead
Work with QA teams to integrate functional and automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to changes in the technical stack and processes
Take a proactive approach to implementing and continuously improving DevOps practices
 Requirements: 
5+ years of hands-on experience in Azure DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineering
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (Azure Landing Zones, Front Door, Storage, App Service, Azure SQL Database)
Experience with or readiness to work on modern Azure compute services (AzureContainer Apps, AKS, Azure Functions)
Solid Infrastructure-as-Code expertise (Bicep, Terraform)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, YAML-based workflows, and Azure DevOps
Experience with GitHub Flow / GitHub Actions (or willingness to adopt)
Strong PowerShell scripting skills
Experience with containerization and Kubernetes-based deployments in Azure
Good understanding of Azure security, IAM, and Entra ID
Understanding of security, compliance, and governance standards, including SOC2 Type 2, within DevOps processes
Strong collaboration and communication skills
English level: Upper-Intermediate or higher
 Nice to Have:
Experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments from an infrastructure or DevOps perspective
Familiarity with Power Platform and the broader Microsoft enterprise ecosystem
 We offer*:
Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
A competitive salary and good compensation package
Personalized career growth
Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
Education reimbursement
Memorable anniversary presents
Corporate events and team buildings
Other location-specific benefits
